parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
An object travels in a circle at constant speed.

State the names of two quantities that vary during the motion of the object.

parts.label: (b)
parts.part_stem:
A charged particle of mass $m$ and with charge $q$ enters a region of uniform magnetic field, perpendicular to the field lines. The magnetic flux density is $B$.

The particle travels in a circle with period $T$ and radius $r$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text:
By considering the magnetic force acting on the particle, show that
$$B = \frac{2\pi m}{qT}.$$

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
The particle is an alpha particle. The period of the circular motion is $2.5\,\mu\text{s}$.

Calculate $B$.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text:
A second alpha particle is in the same uniform field. It travels in a circle of radius $2r$.

State and explain how the periods of the motion of the two particles compare.

parts.label: (b)(iv)
parts.text:
The speed of the alpha particle in (b)(ii) is $1.1 \times 10^6\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. An electric field is applied so that this particle now moves with constant velocity.

Use your answer in (b)(ii) to calculate the electric field strength $E$. Give the unit with your answer.
